answer_1.quote: ...Paraphrase generation (given a sentence, generate its paraphrase) is an area of research benefiting paraphrase detection as well. We used T5 base, as it achieves SOTA on paraphrase generation ...

answer_2.quote: ...BLEURT is a text generation metric building on BERT's contextual word representations. Given any two sentences, BLEURT assigns them a similarity score ... We use BLEURT to measure lexical and syntactic disparity of paraphrases ...
